name: CMOS 3-bit R-2R DAC
description: Three complementary transmission-gate selectors drive a 3-bit R-2R resistor ladder. Three CMOS inverters generate complementary bit controls; all 18 MOS devices and ladder resistors are explicit. The 3.3 V rail is also the reference: ideal output is VDD times code/8. The saved experiment checks all eight codes into 1 Gohm and 100 fF. Finite switch resistance causes small code errors; no output buffer, calibration or precision specification is implied. Generic Level-1 models, nominal 27 C only.
